**Tier basis.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier packages/types/src/zod/theme.zod.ts packages/types/src/theme.ts packages/providers/src/types.ts` — run at dispatch, not recalled — returns *"no path-derived mandate … the tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call (floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable). Clause ② is NOT reachable from paths … judged from the card CONTENT."* Judged from content: this card sits on the **spec-mirroring surface** (`theme.zod.ts` re-exports `@objectstack/spec/ui` zod validators *by reference*), so clause ② is declared `yes` and the card is dispatched **at** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`claude-fable-5`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:2722`) rather than below it. Maintainer authorization for this seat to dispatch above its own served tier, quoted verbatim, 2026-08-22: 「你虽然是 opus，但是可以派 fable 的卡」. No `needs:contract-review` compensating label is attached because none is owed at-tier — and for the record it does not exist in this repo (`scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh:238` creates it for `objectstack-ai/objectstack` only).

**Premise re-verified before dispatch, on `origin/main` (not the shared worktree).**

- objectui `origin/main` = `7138bc1`. All six imports present in `packages/types/src/zod/theme.zod.ts` (import block lines ~21–29). Card's measurement stands.
- objectstack `origin/main` = `95437e7`. All six names return **0** `export` matches under `packages/spec/src/ui/`; control (`PageSchema`, `FormViewSchema`) returns live hits at `page.zod.ts:410` / `view.zod.ts:2394`. The retirement is real and the zero is not a broken grep.

**⚠️ One measured fact the card does not carry — the named file is not the whole dangling set.** `packages/providers` imports `ThemeModeSchema` **directly** from `@objectstack/spec/ui` at `src/types.ts:2` (feeding `ThemePreference` at `:39`) and in two tests (`__tests__/spec-symbol-batch7.test.ts:28-29`, `__tests__/theme-mode-spec-parity.test.tsx:21`). Against the framework tree those dangle for exactly the same reason. Treat this as a **PM mechanism assumption, not a finding to accept on my word** — re-measure it, and see the dispatch brief for how the ruling's observable requirement (a green Console Pin Gate) governs whether they are in scope.

## ACCEPT (on merits) — PR #5713 · reviewer of record, `domain:ui` seat, round 17

⚠️ **On merits, not yet cleared to land.** CI convergence is the reviewer's side of the contract, and at review time it is **not green**: gates read **by name** at head `64e469a` give 12 `success` + 3 `skipped` (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)`, the unexpanded shard placeholder) + **7 `in_progress`** — all four test shards, `Lint`, `Type Check`, `Bundle Analysis`. `in_progress` is an honest reading, not a failure. ⛔ This PR is **not** flipped ready and **not** enqueued until 19 success + those 3 skipped is verified by name. Noting for the record that four `check_suite.completed → success` webhooks fired on this head at 20:21Z while those seven jobs were still running: **the aggregate is not a gate reading**, demonstrated again here rather than recalled.

**Checked against GitHub and the tree, not against the report's self-description.**

| item | verdict |
|---|---|
| PR shape | draft ✓, base `main` ✓, `Fixes #5710` first line ✓ |
| Fence | 7 files, all `packages/types/**` + changeset. Zero `app-shell`/`providers`/`components`/`apps` — verified by `git diff --stat origin/main...` on the fetched head ✓ |
| Changeset | present, `@object-ui/types` minor, no major ✓ |
| `Build Docs` | success in 12s — correctly a path-filtered no-op; no docs surface touched ✓ |
| Out-of-scope findings | #5715 and #5716 both exist ✓ |

**The conditional stop did not fire, and it did not fire for the right reason.** Zone 2b permitted removal and required a stop-and-report before hand-writing any schema body. The dev collapsed the fork by measurement — no engine or provider code consumes the runtime validators (they consume the `Theme` / `ThemePreference` **types** via the pin), so nothing forced localizing. A stop condition discharged by measuring the risk it proxies for, rather than by being argued around, is the outcome that clause is for.

**Three corrections to my dispatch, all measured. Recorded because a seat that only records its wins learns nothing:**

1. **My consumer census was incomplete.** I listed the barrel re-exports, `theme.ts` and the providers `typeof` read as the runtime consumers. I missed `ThemePreviewSchema.theme` / `.mode` at `theme.zod.ts:101-102`, which consumed `ThemeDefinitionSchema` / `ThemeModeSchema` **at runtime**. Had localization been forced, it would have been forced *there* — the one place my brief did not look.
2. **My assumption #2 was right about the imports and wrong about their consequence.** I flagged three `packages/providers` sites as probably dangling and asked whether the gate needed them. Measured: `src/types.ts:2` is `import type`, erased at emit, and the two test files sit outside every bundle graph — so none can redden the gate. The dev went further and read the mechanism from objectstack's `ci.yml` + `build-console.sh`: redness comes only from named **value** imports in the console SPA vite build where `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST` aliases the framework spec, and after this PR that set is empty. That is the measurement my brief asked for and it answers the question properly.
3. **The retirement is larger than the card.** The spec deleted `ui/theme.zod.ts` **whole, types included**, so `theme.ts`'s six `export type` re-exports also dangle against the framework tree. Gate-invisible and un-ruled, correctly left alone and filed as **#5716** — which carries the real consequence: **objectui cannot refresh its spec pin past 17.1.0 until that surface is re-homed or dropped.** That does not affect this card's objective (the Console Pin Gate turns on value imports, now empty), but it is the next link in the same chain and should not be discovered twice.

**The one consequential judgement call, recorded here rather than left in a PR body.** Dropping `theme` / `mode` from `ThemePreviewSchema` **widens the accept set**: `BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()` — verified independently at `base.zod.ts:197`, not taken from the report — so those authored keys now pass through **unvalidated** where they were previously checked. I am accepting it, and the reasoning should be legible to whoever revisits it: keeping the props is impossible (the validators are deleted upstream); localizing them is Option B, which the ruling explicitly declined and Zone 2b blocked; explicitly *refusing* the keys would be a new contract decision nobody has ruled. Dropping them is the only branch available without inventing authority. The blast radius is bounded by `theme-preview` being an unregistered kind (0 registry hits, 0 fixtures) — but that fact lives in **#5647, which is open and undecided**, so this widening is a standing dependency on an unresolved card, not a closed question. ⚠️ **Whoever rules #5647 should read this paragraph first.**

**Verification quality.** Reverse verification was trap-guarded and reported in the falsifiable direction: re-adding `ThemeModeSchema` as a local `z.enum` was confirmed on disk (marker count 1) *before* the run, turned `spec-subschema-parity.test.ts` red (1 failed / 13 passed, exit 1) on exactly that name, and after trap restore (marker count 0, `git status` clean) went green 14/14 — direction predicted in advance and observed. The narrowing of the full-farm run is declared as a measurement (zero consumers of the six outside `packages/types`) rather than presented as a clean sweep.

**Platform fact worth keeping — the report marker does not survive this write path.** The dev's first report comment had its `<!-- os-dev-report -->` HTML-comment marker **eaten by the sanitizer**, caught by its own read-back, and superseded by a comment leading with the literal text. Every collection pass that greps for the HTML-comment form is therefore scanning for something that cannot exist on a comment written through this tooling. Being carried to the seat post as a standing platform note.

**Not closed by this comment** — the card closes when #5713 merges via `Fixes`. Landing is blocked only on the seven pending gates.
